name: Universal Enchantment Splitter
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: Syhmac
description: A datapack / mod that allows you to extract (split) enchantments from an enchanted book to two enchanted books. It also allows you to extract (remove) enchantment from an item to the enchanted book.
evidence: Data only, no Java code: Horizon's mod browser imports its data; nothing for Kiln to run.
